3 غَاضَبْتُهُ I made him angry, he also making me angry. (K.) ―
-b2- And I broke off from him, or quitted him, in anger, or enmity. (S, K.) ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا, in the Kur [xxi. 87], means He went away, breaking off from his people, or quitting them, in anger, or enmity. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
